column1: # Shadow corpus exclusions — stack-graphs Phase 1 shadow invalidation, Task 9 Round 2 (Cause 3).
# Columns (tab-separated): test-class FQN, cause tag, one-line justification, disposition.
# Cause tag is one of the unmodeled-refkind:* sub-categories StackGraphBuilder's Phase 1 scope
# (ImportStub/PropertyStub/EnumStub + Package references only — see its own top-of-file javadoc) does
# not cover; disposition is always "phase2-model" here (expected to close once a later phase adds the
# missing model support — same disposition as the checked-in divergence-allowlist.tsv's grammar-info-stub
# row, which is the same class of gap for a different construct).
# Source of truth: this file. legend-pure-m3-stackgraph/pom.xml's shadow-corpus profile mirrors this
# exact class list in its surefire <excludes> (surefire cannot read excludes from an arbitrary resource
# file) — if you add/remove a row here, update the pom's excludes list in the same change, and vice versa.
# Each row names a whole test CLASS, not individual test methods: some listed classes also have test
# methods that pass under the shadow today (e.g. TestMilestoning has ~20 passing methods alongside the
# ~4 that hit unmodeled-refkind:association-property), but the current exclusion mechanism (surefire
# <excludes>, class-granularity only) cannot exclude at method granularity without a much larger pom
# change; excluding the whole class is the documented, accepted precision loss for Round 2 (see
# task-9-report.md's self-review).
# Do not add rows speculatively: a class is added here only after an actual SHADOW_MISSING was observed,
# root-caused to one of these reference kinds, and confirmed NOT explainable by an index/builder fix
# (Round 2 already fixed the two causes that were fixable: accumulate-until-consumed diffs and the
# content-fingerprint identity fallback).
